Our approach demonstrates notable improvements over the existing fusion paradigms. Blurry and semantically ambiguous template images can be restored to improve multi-modal features in the generative fusion paradigm. Experiments show that our method establishes a new state-of-the-art on multiple benchmarks and achieves an impressive inference speed. The code and models will be released at: https://github.com/Confetti-lxy/GLAD

title: Eternagram: Inspiring Climate Action Through LLM-based Conversational Exploration of a Post-Devastation Climate Future
summary: Climate action is difficult to persuade because we tend to perceive climate change as remote and disconnected from daily life. Instead of traditional informational engagements, game-based interventions can create narratives that immerse the visitor in situations where their actions have tangible consequences. To make these narratives engaging, we used a speculative scenario of an alien stumbling upon social media to obliquely address climate change through a text-based adventure game installation. Mimicking visitors' natural dialogue in social media apps, we designed an LLM-based chatbot with knowledge of post-climate devastated world that mirrors our own planet Earth. In discovering the world's downfall through interactive chatting and posted images, players begin to realize that their own actions can make a difference on impacts of climate change in this distant world, fostering pro-environmental attitudes. Previously published at CHI, this game installation demonstrates the potential of LLM based creative narratives in exploring speculative worlds driving social change.

title: When Classes Evolve: A Benchmark and Framework for Stage-Aware Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to sequentially learn new classes while mitigating catastrophic forgetting of previously learned knowledge. Conventional CIL approaches implicitly assume that classes are morphologically static, focusing primarily on preserving previously learned representations as new classes are introduced. However, this assumption neglects intra-class evolution: a phenomenon wherein instances of the same semantic class undergo significant morphological transformations, such as a larva turning into a butterfly. Consequently, a model must both discriminate between classes and adapt to evolving appearances within a single class. To systematically address this challenge, we formalize Stage-Aware CIL (Stage-CIL), a paradigm in which each class is learned progressively through distinct morphological stages. To facilitate rigorous evaluation within this paradigm, we introduce the Stage-Bench, a 10-domain, 2-stages dataset and protocol that jointly measure inter- and intra-class forgetting. We further propose STAGE, a novel method that explicitly learns abstract and transferable evolution patterns within a fixed-size memory pool. By decoupling semantic identity from transformation dynamics, STAGE enables accurate prediction of future morphologies based on earlier representations. Extensive empirical evaluation demonstrates that STAGE consistently and substantially outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, highlighting its effectiveness in simultaneously addressing inter-class discrimination and intra-class morphological adaptation.

title: Learning Modal-Mixed Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Latent Embeddings
summary: We study how to extend chain-of-thought (CoT) beyond language to better handle multimodal reasoning. While CoT helps LLMs and VLMs articulate intermediate steps, its text-only form often fails on vision-intensive problems where key intermediate states are inherently visual. We introduce modal-mixed CoT, which interleaves textual tokens with compact visual sketches represented as latent embeddings. To bridge the modality gap without eroding the original knowledge and capability of the VLM, we use the VLM itself as an encoder and train the language backbone to reconstruct its own intermediate vision embeddings, to guarantee the semantic alignment of the visual latent space. We further attach a diffusion-based latent decoder, invoked by a special control token and conditioned on hidden states from the VLM. In this way, the diffusion head carries fine-grained perceptual details while the VLM specifies high-level intent, which cleanly disentangles roles and reduces the optimization pressure of the VLM. Training proceeds in two stages: supervised fine-tuning on traces that interleave text and latents with a joint next-token and latent-reconstruction objective, followed by reinforcement learning that teaches when to switch modalities and how to compose long reasoning chains. Extensive experiments across 11 diverse multimodal reasoning tasks, demonstrate that our method yields better performance than language-only and other CoT methods. Our code will be publicly released.

title: Agentic Reward Modeling: Verifying GUI Agent via Online Proactive Interaction
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is pivotal for the continuous evolution of GUI agents, yet existing evaluation paradigms face significant limitations. Rule-based methods suffer from poor scalability and cannot handle open-ended tasks, while LLM-as-a-Judge approaches rely on passive visual observation, often failing to capture latent system states due to partial state observability. To address these challenges, we advocate for a paradigm shift from passive evaluation to Agentic Interactive Verification. We introduce VAGEN, a framework that employs a verifier agent equipped with interaction tools to autonomously plan verification strategies and proactively probe the environment for evidence of task completion. Leveraging the insight that GUI tasks are typically "easy to verify but hard to solve", VAGEN overcomes the bottlenecks of visual limitations. Experimental results on OSWorld-Verified and AndroidWorld benchmarks demonstrate that VAGEN significantly improves evaluation accuracy compared to LLM-as-a-Judge baselines and further enhances performance through test-time scaling strategies.

title: Data Distribution as a Lever for Guiding Optimizers Toward Superior Generalization in LLMs
summary: Can modifying the training data distribution guide optimizers toward solutions with improved generalization when training large language models (LLMs)? In this work, we theoretically analyze an in-context linear regression model with multi-head linear self-attention, and compare the training dynamics of two gradient based optimizers, namely gradient descent (GD) and sharpness-aware minimization (SAM), the latter exhibiting superior generalization properties but is prohibitively expensive for training even medium-sized LLMs. We show, for the first time, that SAM induces a lower simplicity bias (SB)-the tendency of an optimizer to preferentially learn simpler features earlier in training-and identify this reduction as a key factor underlying its improved generalization performance. Motivated by this insight, we demonstrate that altering the training data distribution by upsampling or augmenting examples learned later in training similarly reduces SB and leads to improved generalization. Our extensive experiments show that our strategy improves the performance of multiple LLMs-including Phi2-2.7B , Llama3.2-1B, Gemma3-1B-PT, and Qwen3-0.6B-Base-achieving relative accuracy gains up to 18% when fine-tuned with AdamW and Muon on mathematical reasoning tasks.

title: Sparsity-Aware Unlearning for Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) inevitably memorize sensitive information during training, posing significant privacy risks. Machine unlearning has emerged as a promising solution to selectively remove such information without full retraining. However, existing methods are designed for dense models and overlook model sparsification-an essential technique for efficient LLM deployment. We find that unlearning effectiveness degrades substantially on sparse models. Through empirical analysis, we reveal that this degradation occurs because existing unlearning methods require updating all parameters, yet sparsification prunes substantial weights to zero, fundamentally limiting the model's forgetting capacity. To address this challenge, we propose Sparsity-Aware Unlearning (SAU), which decouples unlearning from sparsification objectives through gradient masking that redirects updates to surviving weights, combined with importance-aware redistribution to compensate for pruned parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAU significantly outperforms existing methods on sparse LLMs, achieving effective forgetting while preserving model utility.

title: Bridging Degradation Discrimination and Generation for Universal Image Restoration
summary: Universal image restoration is a critical task in low-level vision, requiring the model to remove various degradations from low-quality images to produce clean images with rich detail. The challenges lie in sampling the distribution of high-quality images and adjusting the outputs on the basis of the degradation. This paper presents a novel approach, Bridging Degradation discrimination and Generation (BDG), which aims to address these challenges concurrently. First, we propose the Multi-Angle and multi-Scale Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (MAS-GLCM) and demonstrate its effectiveness in performing fine-grained discrimination of degradation types and levels. Subsequently, we divide the diffusion training process into three distinct stages: generation, bridging, and restoration. The objective is to preserve the diffusion model's capability of restoring rich textures while simultaneously integrating the discriminative information from the MAS-GLCM into the restoration process. This enhances its proficiency in addressing multi-task and multi-degraded scenarios. Without changing the architecture, BDG achieves significant performance gains in all-in-one restoration and real-world super-resolution tasks, primarily evidenced by substantial improvements in fidelity without compromising perceptual quality. The code and pretrained models are provided in https://github.com/MILab-PKU/BDG.

title: Small Shifts, Large Gains: Unlocking Traditional TSP Heuristic Guided-Sampling via Unsupervised Neural Instance Modification
summary: The Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) is one of the most representative NP-hard problems in route planning and a long-standing benchmark in combinatorial optimization. Traditional heuristic tour constructors, such as Farthest or Nearest Insertion, are computationally efficient and highly practical, but their deterministic behavior limits exploration and often leads to local optima. In contrast, neural-based heuristic tour constructors alleviate this issue through guided-sampling and typically achieve superior solution quality, but at the cost of extensive training and reliance on ground-truth supervision, hindering their practical use. To bridge this gap, we propose TSP-MDF, a novel instance modification framework that equips traditional deterministic heuristic tour constructors with guided-sampling capability. Specifically, TSP-MDF introduces a neural-based instance modifier that strategically shifts node coordinates to sample multiple modified instances, on which the base traditional heuristic tour constructor constructs tours that are mapped back to the original instance, allowing traditional tour constructors to explore higher-quality tours and escape local optima. At the same time, benefiting from our instance modification formulation, the neural-based instance modifier can be trained efficiently without any ground-truth supervision, ensuring the framework maintains practicality. Extensive experiments on large-scale TSP benchmarks and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that TSP-MDF significantly improves the performance of traditional heuristics tour constructors, achieving solution quality comparable to neural-based heuristic tour constructors, but with an extremely short training time.

title: Bridging Time and Frequency: A Joint Modeling Framework for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting (IMTSF) is challenging due to non-uniform sampling and variable asynchronicity. These irregularities violate the equidistant assumptions of standard models, hindering local temporal modeling and rendering classical frequency-domain methods ineffective for capturing global periodic structures. To address this challenge, we propose TFMixer, a joint time-frequency modeling framework for IMTS forecasting. Specifically, TFMixer incorporates a Global Frequency Module that employs a learnable Non-Uniform Discrete Fourier Transform (NUDFT) to directly extract spectral representations from irregular timestamps. In parallel, the Local Time Module introduces a query-based patch mixing mechanism to adaptively aggregate informative temporal patches and alleviate information density imbalance. Finally, TFMixer fuses the time-domain and frequency-domain representations to generate forecasts and further leverages inverse NUDFT for explicit seasonal extrapolation. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate the state--of-the-art performance of TFMixer.

title: MAUGen: A Unified Diffusion Approach for Multi-Identity Facial Expression and AU Label Generation
summary: The lack of large-scale, demographically diverse face images with precise Action Unit (AU) occurrence and intensity annotations has long been recognized as a fundamental bottleneck in developing generalizable AU recognition systems. In this paper, we propose MAUGen, a diffusion-based multi-modal framework that jointly generates a large collection of photorealistic facial expressions and anatomically consistent AU labels, including both occurrence and intensity, conditioned on a single descriptive text prompt. Our MAUGen involves two key modules: (1) a Multi-modal Representation Learning (MRL) module that captures the relationships among the paired textual description, facial identity, expression image, and AU activations within a unified latent space; and (2) a Diffusion-based Image label Generator (DIG) that decodes the joint representation into aligned facial image-label pairs across diverse identities. Under this framework, we introduce Multi-Identity Facial Action (MIFA), a large-scale multimodal synthetic dataset featuring comprehensive AU annotations and identity variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAUGen outperforms existing methods in synthesizing photorealistic, demographically diverse facial images along with semantically aligned AU labels.

title: Exploring Information Seeking Agent Consolidation
summary: Information-seeking agents have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing information-seeking agents are typically specialized for open web, documents, or local knowledge bases, which constrains scalability and cross-domain generalization. In this work, we investigate how to consolidate heterogeneous information-seeking agents into a single foundation agentic model. We study two complementary consolidation strategies: data-level consolidation, which jointly trains a unified model on a mixture of domain-specific datasets, and parameter-level consolidation, which merges independently trained agent models at the parameter level. Our analysis compares these approaches in terms of performance retention, cross-domain generalization, and interference across information-seeking behaviors. Our results show that data-level consolidation remains a strong and stable baseline, while parameter-level consolidation offers a promising, efficient alternative but suffers from interference and robustness challenges. We further identify key design factors for effective agent consolidation at the parameter level, including fine-grained merging granularity, awareness of task heterogeneity, and principled consensus strategy.

title: Safe Langevin Soft Actor Critic
summary: Balancing reward and safety in constrained reinforcement learning remains challenging due to poor generalization from sharp value minima and inadequate handling of heavy-tailed risk distribution. We introduce Safe Langevin Soft Actor-Critic (SL-SAC), a principled algorithm that addresses both issues through parameter-space exploration and distributional risk control. Our approach combines three key mechanisms: (1) Adaptive Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (aSGLD) for reward critics, promoting ensemble diversity and escape from poor optima; (2) distributional cost estimation via Implicit Quantile Networks (IQN) with Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) optimization for tail-risk mitigation; and (3) a reactive Lagrangian relaxation scheme that adapts constraint enforcement based on the empirical CVaR of episodic costs. We provide theoretical guarantees on CVaR estimation error and demonstrate that CVaR-based Lagrange updates yield stronger constraint violation signals than expected-cost updates. On Safety-Gymnasium benchmarks, SL-SAC achieves the lowest cost in 7 out of 10 tasks while maintaining competitive returns, with cost reductions of 19-63% in velocity tasks compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

title: The French Drama Revolution: Political Economy and Literary Production, 1700-1900
summary: This paper investigates the changing nature of French drama between 1700-1900 using Latent Dirichlet Allocation and Jensen-Shannon Divergence. Results indicate that the topical distribution of French drama changed profoundly after the French Revolution, particularly between 1789 and 1850. Bourgeois themes emerged among the most prevalent topics since the late 18th century. To assess the coevolution of drama and economic growth, I plot the yearly prevalence of topics alongside French GDP between 1700-1900, and discuss these changes in light of the political and economic changes prompted by the French Revolution and the industrialization of the country.

title: SEER: Transformer-based Robust Time Series Forecasting via Automated Patch Enhancement and Replacement
summary: Time series forecasting is important in many fields that require accurate predictions for decision-making. Patching techniques, commonly used and effective in time series modeling, help capture temporal dependencies by dividing the data into patches. However, existing patch-based methods fail to dynamically select patches and typically use all patches during the prediction process. In real-world time series, there are often low-quality issues during data collection, such as missing values, distribution shifts, anomalies and white noise, which may cause some patches to contain low-quality information, negatively impacting the prediction results. To address this issue, this study proposes a robust time series forecasting framework called SEER. Firstly, we propose an Augmented Embedding Module, which improves patch-wise representations using a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture and obtains series-wise token representations through a channel-adaptive perception mechanism. Secondly, we introduce a Learnable Patch Replacement Module, which enhances forecasting robustness and model accuracy through a two-stage process: 1) a dynamic filtering mechanism eliminates negative patch-wise tokens; 2) a replaced attention module substitutes the identified low-quality patches with global series-wise token, further refining their representations through a causal attention mechanism. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate the SOTA performance of SEER.

title: DockSmith: Scaling Reliable Coding Environments via an Agentic Docker Builder
summary: Reliable Docker-based environment construction is a dominant bottleneck for scaling execution-grounded training and evaluation of software engineering agents. We introduce DockSmith, a specialized agentic Docker builder designed to address this challenge. DockSmith treats environment construction not only as a preprocessing step, but as a core agentic capability that exercises long-horizon tool use, dependency reasoning, and failure recovery, yielding supervision that transfers beyond Docker building itself. DockSmith is trained on large-scale, execution-grounded Docker-building trajectories produced by a SWE-Factory-style pipeline augmented with a loop-detection controller and a cross-task success memory. Training a 30B-A3B model on these trajectories achieves open-source state-of-the-art performance on Multi-Docker-Eval, with 39.72% Fail-to-Pass and 58.28% Commit Rate. Moreover, DockSmith improves out-of-distribution performance on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and Terminal-Bench 2.0, demonstrating broader agentic benefits of environment construction.

title: From Pixels to Facts (Pix2Fact): Benchmarking Multi-Hop Reasoning for Fine-Grained Visual Fact Checking
summary: Despite progress on general tasks, VLMs struggle with challenges demanding both detailed visual grounding and deliberate knowledge-based reasoning, a synergy not captured by existing benchmarks that evaluate these skills separately. To close this gap, we introduce Pix2Fact, a new visual question-answering benchmark designed to evaluate expert-level perception and knowledge-intensive multi-hop reasoning. Pix2Fact contains 1,000 high-resolution (4K+) images spanning 8 daily-life scenarios and situations, with questions and answers meticulously crafted by annotators holding PhDs from top global universities working in partnership with a professional data annotation firm. Each question requires detailed visual grounding, multi-hop reasoning, and the integration of external knowledge to answer. Our evaluation of 9 state-of-the-art VLMs, including proprietary models like Gemini-3-Pro and GPT-5, reveals the substantial challenge posed by Pix2Fact: the most advanced model achieves only 24.0% average accuracy, in stark contrast to human performance of 56%. This significant gap underscores the limitations of current models in replicating human-level visual comprehension. We believe Pix2Fact will serve as a critical benchmark to drive the development of next-generation multimodal agents that combine fine-grained perception with robust, knowledge-based reasoning.

title: Kanade: A Simple Disentangled Tokenizer for Spoken Language Modeling
summary: A good language model starts with a good tokenizer. Tokenization is especially important for speech modeling, which must handle continuous signals that mix linguistic and non-linguistic information. A speech tokenizer should extract phonetics and prosody, suppress linguistically irrelevant information like speaker identity, and enable high-quality synthesis. We present Kanade, a single-layer disentangled speech tokenizer that realizes this ideal. Kanade separates out acoustic constants to create a single stream of tokens that captures rich phonetics and prosody. It does so without the need for auxiliary methods that existing disentangled codecs often rely on. Experiments show that Kanade achieves state-of-the-art speaker disentanglement and lexical availability, while maintaining excellent reconstruction quality.

title: Kernelized Edge Attention: Addressing Semantic Attention Blurring in Temporal Graph Neural Networks
summary: Temporal Graph Neural Networks (TGNNs) aim to capture the evolving structure and timing of interactions in dynamic graphs. Although many models incorporate time through encodings or architectural design, they often compute attention over entangled node and edge representations, failing to reflect their distinct temporal behaviors. Node embeddings evolve slowly as they aggregate long-term structural context, while edge features reflect transient, timestamped interactions (e.g. messages, trades, or transactions). This mismatch results in semantic attention blurring, where attention weights cannot distinguish between slowly drifting node states and rapidly changing, information-rich edge interactions. As a result, models struggle to capture fine-grained temporal dependencies and provide limited transparency into how temporal relevance is computed. This paper introduces KEAT (Kernelized Edge Attention for Temporal Graphs), a novel attention formulation that modulates edge features using a family of continuous-time kernels, including Laplacian, RBF, and learnable MLP variant. KEAT preserves the distinct roles of nodes and edges, and integrates seamlessly with both Transformer-style (e.g., DyGFormer) and message-passing (e.g., TGN) architectures. It achieves up to 18% MRR improvement over the recent DyGFormer and 7% over TGN on link prediction tasks, enabling more accurate, interpretable and temporally aware message passing in TGNNs.

title: Hermes the Polyglot: A Unified Framework to Enhance Expressiveness for Multimodal Interlingual Subtitling
summary: Interlingual subtitling, which translates subtitles of visual media into a target language, is essential for entertainment localization but has not yet been explored in machine translation. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced the general capabilities of machine translation, the distinctive characteristics of subtitle texts pose persistent challenges in interlingual subtitling, particularly regarding semantic coherence, pronoun and terminology translation, and translation expressiveness. To address these issues, we present Hermes, an LLM-based automated subtitling framework. Hermes integrates three modules: Speaker Diarization, Terminology Identification, and Expressiveness Enhancement, which effectively tackle the above challenges. Experiments demonstrate that Hermes achieves state-of-the-art diarization performance and generates expressive, contextually coherent translations, thereby advancing research in interlingual subtitling.

title: Direct Preference Optimization with Rating Information: Practical Algorithms and Provable Gains
summary: The class of direct preference optimization (DPO) algorithms has emerged as a promising approach for solving the alignment problem in foundation models. These algorithms work with very limited feedback in the form of pairwise preferences and fine-tune models to align with these preferences without explicitly learning a reward model. While the form of feedback used by these algorithms makes the data collection process easy and relatively more accurate, its ambiguity in terms of the quality of responses could have negative implications. For example, it is not clear if a decrease (increase) in the likelihood of preferred (dispreferred) responses during the execution of these algorithms could be interpreted as a positive or negative phenomenon. In this paper, we study how to design algorithms that can leverage additional information in the form of rating gap, which informs the learner how much the chosen response is better than the rejected one. We present new algorithms that can achieve faster statistical rates than DPO in presence of accurate rating gap information. Moreover, we theoretically prove and empirically show that the performance of our algorithms is robust to inaccuracy in rating gaps. Finally, we demonstrate the solid performance of our methods in comparison to a number of DPO-style algorithms across a wide range of LLMs and evaluation benchmarks.

title: The TMU System for the XACLE Challenge: Training Large Audio Language Models with CLAP Pseudo-Labels
comments: 3 pages; 2 figures; 2 tables; Accepted at ICASSP 2026 Workshop (SP Grand Challenges, GC-12: XACLE)
summary: In this paper, we propose a submission to the x-to-audio alignment (XACLE) challenge. The goal is to predict semantic alignment of a given general audio and text pair. The proposed system is based on a large audio language model (LALM) architecture. We employ a three-stage training pipeline: automated audio captioning pretraining, pretraining with CLAP pseudo-labels, and fine-tuning on the XACLE dataset. Our experiments show that pretraining with CLAP pseudo-labels is the primary performance driver. On the XACLE test set, our system reaches an SRCC of 0.632, significantly outperforming the baseline system (0.334) and securing third place in the challenge team ranking. Code and models can be found at https://github.com/shiotalab-tmu/tmu-xacle2026
comment: 3 pages; 2 figures; 2 tables; Accepted at ICASSP 2026 Workshop (SP Grand Challenges, GC-12: XACLE)

title: Actor-Dual-Critic Dynamics for Zero-sum and Identical-Interest Stochastic Games
summary: We propose a novel independent and payoff-based learning framework for stochastic games that is model-free, game-agnostic, and gradient-free. The learning dynamics follow a best-response-type actor-critic architecture, where agents update their strategies (actors) using feedback from two distinct critics: a fast critic that intuitively responds to observed payoffs under limited information, and a slow critic that deliberatively approximates the solution to the underlying dynamic programming problem. Crucially, the learning process relies on non-equilibrium adaptation through smoothed best responses to observed payoffs. We establish convergence to (approximate) equilibria in two-agent zero-sum and multi-agent identical-interest stochastic games over an infinite horizon. This provides one of the first payoff-based and fully decentralized learning algorithms with theoretical guarantees in both settings. Empirical results further validate the robustness and effectiveness of the proposed approach across both classes of games.

AI.title_translation: 零和与同利随机博弈的Actor-Dual-Critic动力学
AI.tldr: 提出一种新颖的、基于回报的、无模型、无梯度的Actor-Dual-Critic学习框架，用于随机博弈，并在零和与同利博弈中证明了收敛到近似均衡，具有理论保证。
AI.motivation: 解决随机博弈中模型无关、游戏无关、无梯度的独立和基于回报的学习问题，并为之提供理论保证。
AI.method: 提出一个独立且基于回报的学习框架，采用最佳响应类型的Actor-Critic架构。智能体（actor）利用两个不同的critic的反馈更新策略：一个快速critic响应有限信息下的观察回报，一个慢速critic近似动态规划问题的解。学习过程依赖于通过对观察回报的平滑最佳响应实现的非均衡适应。
AI.result: 建立了在两智能体零和以及多智能体同利随机博弈中，算法收敛到（近似）均衡的理论证明。这是首批在两种设置下都具有理论保证的基于回报且完全去中心化的学习算法之一。实证结果进一步验证了该方法在两类博弈中的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的Actor-Dual-Critic动力学为零和与同利随机博弈提供了一种新颖的、具有理论保证的、基于回报的、完全去中心化的学习算法，并在实践中表现出鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种新颖的、独立且基于回报的随机博弈学习框架，该框架是无模型、游戏无关且无梯度的。学习动力遵循一种最佳响应类型的Actor-Critic架构，其中智能体（actor）利用来自两个不同critic的反馈来更新其策略：一个快速critic在有限信息下直观地响应观察到的回报，一个慢速critic则深思熟虑地近似底层动态规划问题的解。至关重要的是，学习过程依赖于通过对观察到的回报进行平滑最佳响应的非均衡适应。我们建立了在无限视野下的两智能体零和以及多智能体同利随机博弈中，收敛到（近似）均衡的理论证明。这提供了首批在两种设置下都具有理论保证的基于回报且完全去中心化的学习算法之一。实证结果进一步验证了所提出方法在两类博弈中的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的Actor-Dual-Critic学习框架，旨在解决随机博弈中的独立、基于回报、无模型、游戏无关和无梯度学习问题。该框架采用最佳响应类型的Actor-Critic架构，通过快速和慢速两种critic的反馈以及平滑最佳响应的非均衡适应来更新策略。研究证明了该算法在两智能体零和与多智能体同利随机博弈中收敛到近似均衡，并提供了理论保证，是该领域内首批具有此类特性的算法之一。实证结果也支持了其鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.keywords: 随机博弈, Actor-Critic, 去中心化学习, 零和博弈, 同利博弈
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于提出了一个独特的Actor-Dual-Critic架构，结合了快速和慢速两种critic，并通过非均衡适应实现学习，同时提供了在零和与同利随机博弈两种重要设置下的理论收敛保证。其无模型、游戏无关和无梯度的特性使其具有广泛的应用潜力，是去中心化多智能体学习领域的一个重要进展。

title: MTAVG-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Talker Dialogue-Centric Audio-Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation have enabled models to synthesize audio-visual videos with multi-participant dialogues. However, existing evaluation benchmarks remain largely designed for human-recorded videos or single-speaker settings. As a result, potential errors that occur in generated multi-talker dialogue videos, such as identity drift, unnatural turn transitions, and audio-visual misalignment, cannot be effectively captured and analyzed. To address this issue, we introduce MTAVG-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating audio-visual multi-speaker dialogue generation. MTAVG-Bench is built via a semi-automatic pipeline, where 1.8k videos are generated using multiple popular models with carefully designed prompts, yielding 2.4k manually annotated QA pairs. The benchmark evaluates multi-speaker dialogue generation at four levels: audio-visual signal fidelity, temporal attribute consistency, social interaction, and cinematic expression. We benchmark 12 proprietary and open-source omni-models on MTAVG-Bench, with Gemini 3 Pro achieving the strongest overall performance, while leading open-source models remain competitive in signal fidelity and consistency. Overall, MTAVG-Bench enables fine-grained failure analysis for rigorous model comparison and targeted video generation refinement.

AI.title_translation: MTAVG-Bench：一个用于评估多说话者对话中心音视频生成的综合基准
AI.tldr: MTAVG-Bench是一个新的基准，用于评估多说话者对话音视频生成模型，揭示了现有模型的缺陷并促进了精细化分析。
AI.motivation: 现有评估基准主要针对人类录制视频或单说话者设置，无法有效捕捉生成的多说话者对话视频中出现的潜在错误，如身份漂移、不自然的轮次转换和音视频错位。
AI.method: 引入MTAVG-Bench，通过半自动化流程构建，生成了1.8k视频并产生了2.4k手动标注的QA对。该基准从音视频信号保真度、时间属性一致性、社会互动和电影表达四个层面评估多说话者对话生成。
AI.result: 在MTAVG-Bench上对12个专有和开源全能模型进行了基准测试，Gemini 3 Pro取得了最强的整体性能，而领先的开源模型在信号保真度和一致性方面仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: MTAVG-Bench有助于进行细粒度的故障分析，以实现严格的模型比较和有针对性的视频生成改进。
AI.translation: 最近文本到音视频（T2AV）生成的进展使得模型能够合成包含多参与者对话的音视频。然而，现有的评估基准在很大程度上仍是为人类录制视频或单说话者设置设计的。因此，在生成的多说话者对话视频中可能出现的错误，如身份漂移、不自然的轮次转换和音视频错位，无法被有效捕获和分析。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了MTAVG-Bench，这是一个用于评估音视频多说话者对话生成的基准。MTAVG-Bench通过半自动化流程构建，其中使用多个流行模型和精心设计的提示生成了1.8k个视频，产生了2.4k个手动标注的QA对。该基准从四个层面评估多说话者对话生成：音视频信号保真度、时间属性一致性、社会互动和电影表达。我们在MTAVG-Bench上对12个专有和开源全能模型进行了基准测试，Gemini 3 Pro取得了最强的整体性能，而领先的开源模型在信号保真度和一致性方面仍具竞争力。总的来说，MTAVG-Bench能够实现细粒度的故障分析，以进行严格的模型比较和有针对性的视频生成改进。
AI.summary: MTAVG-Bench是一个新的综合基准，旨在解决现有评估工具在多说话者对话音视频生成中存在的不足。它通过半自动化流程构建了包含1.8k视频和2.4k标注QA对的数据集，并从四个关键维度评估模型性能，从而实现对生成模型更精细的错误分析和改进。基准测试结果显示Gemini 3 Pro表现最佳，而开源模型在特定方面仍有竞争力。
AI.keywords: 多说话者对话, 音视频生成, 基准, 评估, T2AV
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入MTAVG-Bench，填补了多说话者对话音视频生成领域评估基准的空白。其创新之处在于提出了一个能捕捉多说话者特有错误（如身份漂移、不自然轮次转换和音视频错位）的全面评估框架。这对于推动T2AV技术向更真实、更复杂的对话场景发展至关重要，并能促进对模型缺陷的精细化分析和改进。

title: Scalable Generative Game Engine: Breaking the Resolution Wall via Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design
summary: Real-time generative game engines represent a paradigm shift in interactive simulation, promising to replace traditional graphics pipelines with neural world models. However, existing approaches are fundamentally constrained by the ``Memory Wall,'' restricting practical deployments to low resolutions (e.g., $64 \times 64$). This paper bridges the gap between generative models and high-resolution neural simulations by introducing a scalable \textit{Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design} framework. We identify that high-resolution generation suffers from a critical resource mismatch: the World Model is compute-bound while the Decoder is memory-bound. To address this, we propose a heterogeneous architecture that intelligently decouples these components across a cluster of AI accelerators. Our system features three core innovations: (1) an asymmetric resource allocation strategy that optimizes throughput under sequence parallelism constraints; (2) a memory-centric operator fusion scheme that minimizes off-chip bandwidth usage; and (3) a manifold-aware latent extrapolation mechanism that exploits temporal redundancy to mask latency. We validate our approach on a cluster of programmable AI accelerators, enabling real-time generation at $720 \times 480$ resolution -- a $50\times$ increase in pixel throughput over prior baselines. Evaluated on both continuous 3D racing and discrete 2D platformer benchmarks, our system delivers fluid 26.4 FPS and 48.3 FPS respectively, with an amortized effective latency of 2.7 ms. This work demonstrates that resolving the ``Memory Wall'' via architectural co-design is not merely an optimization, but a prerequisite for enabling high-fidelity, responsive neural gameplay.

AI.title_translation: 可扩展生成式游戏引擎：通过硬件-算法协同设计打破分辨率壁垒
AI.tldr: 该研究通过硬件-算法协同设计，解决了生成式游戏引擎的分辨率限制（“内存墙”问题），实现了高分辨率实时神经模拟，将像素吞吐量提高了50倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的实时生成式游戏引擎受限于“内存墙”问题，实际部署只能在低分辨率（如64x64）下进行，无法实现高分辨率的神经模拟，这限制了其在互动模拟中的应用潜力。
AI.method: 论文提出了一种可扩展的硬件-算法协同设计框架。该框架识别出高分辨率生成中世界模型受计算限制而解码器受内存限制的关键资源不匹配问题。为解决此问题，提出了一种异构架构，智能地将这些组件解耦到AI加速器集群中。核心创新包括：1) 优化吞吐量的非对称资源分配策略；2) 最小化片外带宽使用的以内存为中心的操作融合方案；3) 利用时间冗余掩盖延迟的流形感知潜在外推机制。
AI.result: 该方法在可编程AI加速器集群上验证，实现了720x480分辨率的实时生成，像素吞吐量比现有基线提高了50倍。在连续3D赛车和离散2D平台游戏基准测试中，系统分别提供了流畅的26.4 FPS和48.3 FPS，摊销有效延迟为2.7毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构协同设计解决“内存墙”问题不仅仅是一种优化，更是实现高保真、响应迅速的神经游戏体验的先决条件。
AI.translation: 实时生成式游戏引擎代表了交互式模拟的范式转变，有望用神经世界模型取代传统的图形管线。然而，现有方法从根本上受到“内存墙”的限制，将实际部署限制在低分辨率（例如64x64）。本文通过引入一个可扩展的硬件-算法协同设计框架，弥合了生成模型与高分辨率神经模拟之间的鸿沟。我们发现高分辨率生成面临一个关键的资源不匹配问题：世界模型受计算限制，而解码器受内存限制。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种异构架构，智能地将这些组件解耦到AI加速器集群中。我们的系统具有三个核心创新：(1) 一种在序列并行约束下优化吞吐量的非对称资源分配策略；(2) 一种最小化片外带宽使用的以内存为中心的操作融合方案；(3) 一种利用时间冗余掩盖延迟的流形感知潜在外推机制。我们在一个可编程AI加速器集群上验证了我们的方法，实现了720x480分辨率的实时生成——像素吞吐量比现有基线提高了50倍。在连续3D赛车和离散2D平台游戏基准测试中，我们的系统分别提供了流畅的26.4 FPS和48.3 FPS，摊销有效延迟为2.7毫秒。这项工作表明，通过架构协同设计解决“内存墙”问题不仅仅是一种优化，更是实现高保真、响应迅速的神经游戏体验的先决条件。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种可扩展的硬件-算法协同设计框架，旨在解决实时生成式游戏引擎中因“内存墙”导致的高分辨率限制。通过识别世界模型计算受限和解码器内存受限的资源不匹配问题，该研究设计了一个异构架构，并引入了非对称资源分配、内存中心操作融合和流形感知潜在外推三项创新。实验证明，该系统在AI加速器集群上实现了720x480的实时生成，像素吞吐量提升50倍，并在不同游戏类型中展现出流畅的帧率和低延迟，证实了协同设计是实现高保真神经游戏的关键。
AI.keywords: 生成式游戏引擎, 硬件-算法协同设计, 内存墙, 高分辨率, 实时模拟
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过提出硬件-算法协同设计，为生成式游戏引擎在高分辨率下的实时运行提供了创新的解决方案。其核心在于精准识别并解决了“内存墙”导致的资源不匹配问题，并结合了系统架构和算法层面的多项优化。在AI硬件加速日益普及的背景下，这种软硬件协同优化的思路对于推动神经图形和实时生成式AI应用具有重要意义。该工作不仅显著提升了性能，也为未来高保真神经模拟奠定了基础。

title: Structured Self-Consistency:A Multi-Task Evaluation of LLMs on VirtualHome
summary: Embodied AI requires agents to understand goals, plan actions, and execute tasks in simulated environments.We present a comprehensive evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) on the VirtualHome benchmark using the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI) framework.We compare two representative 7B-parameter models OPENPANGU-7B and QWEN2.5-7B across four fundamental tasks: Goal Interpretation, Action Sequencing, Subgoal Decomposition, and Transition Modeling.We propose Structured Self-Consistency (SSC), an enhanced decoding strategy that leverages multiple sampling with domain-specific voting mechanisms to improve output quality for structured generation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that SSC significantly enhances performance, with OPENPANGU-7B excelling at hierarchical planning while QWEN2.5-7B show advantages in action-level tasks. Our analysis reveals complementary strengths across model types, providing insights for future embodied AI system development.

AI.title_translation: 结构化自洽性：对大型语言模型在VirtualHome上多任务的评估
AI.tldr: 研究人员在VirtualHome上用新方法SSC评估了两个7B LLM，发现SSC提高了性能，且两个模型在不同具身AI子任务上各有所长。
AI.motivation: 具身AI要求智能体理解目标、规划动作并在模拟环境中执行任务，因此需要对大型语言模型（LLMs）在这些复杂任务上的能力进行全面和严格的评估。
AI.method: 提出结构化自洽性（SSC）作为一种增强的解码策略，它利用多次采样和特定领域的投票机制来提高结构化生成任务的输出质量。该方法在Embodied Agent Interface (EAI) 框架下，对OPENPANGU-7B和QWEN2.5-7B两个7B模型在虚拟家庭基准的四个任务上进行了评估。
AI.result: SSC显著提高了性能。在具体任务上，OPENPANGU-7B在层次化规划方面表现出色，而QWEN2.5-7B在动作级别任务上显示出优势。
AI.conclusion: 分析揭示了不同模型类型在特定具身AI子任务上存在互补的优势，为未来具身AI系统的开发提供了宝贵的见解。
AI.translation: 具身人工智能要求智能体理解目标、规划动作并在模拟环境中执行任务。我们使用Embodied Agent Interface (EAI) 框架，在VirtualHome基准上对大型语言模型（LLMs）进行了全面的评估。我们将代表性的7B参数模型OPENPANGU-7B和QWEN2.5-7B在四个基本任务上进行了比较：目标解释、动作排序、子目标分解和转换建模。我们提出了结构化自洽性（SSC），这是一种增强的解码策略，它利用多次采样和特定领域的投票机制来提高结构化生成任务的输出质量。实验结果表明，SSC显著提升了性能，其中OPENPANGU-7B在层次化规划方面表现出色，而QWEN2.5-7B在动作级别任务上显示出优势。我们的分析揭示了不同模型类型之间互补的优势，为未来的具身AI系统开发提供了见解。
AI.summary: 本文使用Embodied Agent Interface (EAI) 框架，在VirtualHome基准上对LLMs（OPENPANGU-7B和QWEN2.5-7B）进行了全面评估，并提出了一种名为结构化自洽性（SSC）的新解码策略，以提升结构化生成任务的性能。实验结果表明SSC有效，并揭示了不同模型在层次规划和动作执行等任务上的互补优势。
AI.keywords: 具身AI, 大型语言模型, VirtualHome, 结构化自洽性, 模型评估
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了结构化自洽性（SSC）解码策略，并将其应用于虚拟家庭（VirtualHome）这一具身AI任务的全面评估。其重要性在于为评估和提升LLMs在复杂具身任务中的表现提供了一个新的、更严格的框架和方法。局限性在于仅评估了两个7B参数的模型，泛化性有待进一步验证。

title: Lookahead-then-Verify: Reliable Constrained Decoding for Diffusion LLMs under Context-Free Grammars
summary:
Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have demonstrated promising generative capabilities and are increasingly used to produce formal languages defined by context-free grammars, such as source code and chemical expressions. However, as probabilistic models, they still struggle to generate syntactically valid outputs reliably. A natural and promising direction to address this issue is to adapt constrained decoding techniques to enforce grammatical correctness during generation. However, applying these techniques faces two primary obstacles. On the one hand, the non-autoregressive nature of dLLMs renders most existing constrained decoding approaches inapplicable. On the other hand, current approaches specifically designed for dLLMs may allow intermediate outputs that are impossible to complete into valid sentences, which significantly limits their reliability in practice.
  To address these challenges, we present LAVE, a constrained decoding approach specifically designed for dLLMs. Our approach leverages a key property of dLLMs, namely their ability to predict token distributions for all positions in parallel during each forward pass. Whenever a new token is proposed by model, LAVE performs lookahead using these distributions to efficiently and reliably verify the validity of the proposed token. This design ensures reliable constraints by reliably preserving the potential for intermediate outputs to be extended into valid sentences. Extensive experiments across four widely used dLLMs and three representative benchmarks demonstrate that LAVE consistently outperforms existing baselines and achieves substantial improvements in syntactic correctness, while incurring negligible runtime overhead.

AI.title_translation: 前瞻后验证：扩散大语言模型在无上下文语法约束下的可靠解码
AI.tldr: LAVE是一种新的约束解码方法，用于解决扩散大语言模型（dLLM）在生成形式语言时遇到的语法不正确问题。它通过在每个前向传递中利用dLLM预测所有位置标记分布的能力，对提议的标记进行前瞻和验证，确保中间输出可以完成为有效句子，从而提高了可靠性。实验表明，LAVE在语法正确性方面优于现有方法，且运行时开销极小。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）在生成形式语言（如源代码）时，由于其概率性质，仍然难以保证语法上有效的输出。现有的约束解码技术难以直接应用于dLLM的非自回归特性，并且可能产生无法完成为有效句子的中间输出，限制了其可靠性。
AI.method: LAVE是一种专门为dLLM设计的约束解码方法。它利用dLLM在每个前向传递中并行预测所有位置标记分布的能力。当模型提出新标记时，LAVE利用这些分布进行前瞻，以高效可靠地验证提议标记的有效性。这种设计通过可靠地保留中间输出扩展为有效句子的可能性，确保了约束的可靠性。
AI.result: LAVE在语法正确性方面持续优于现有基线，并取得了显著的改进。同时，它产生的运行时开销可以忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: LAVE是一种有效且可靠的约束解码方法，能够解决dLLM在生成形式语言时遇到的语法不正确问题，并在保持高语法正确性的同时，实现了可忽略不计的运行时开销。
AI.translation:
扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）已展现出有希望的生成能力，并越来越多地用于生成由上下文无关语法定义的正式语言，例如源代码和化学表达式。然而，作为概率模型，它们在可靠地生成语法上有效的输出方面仍然存在挑战。一个自然且有希望的方向是采用约束解码技术，在生成过程中强制执行语法正确性。然而，应用这些技术面临两个主要障碍。一方面，dLLMs的非自回归性质使得大多数现有的约束解码方法不适用。另一方面，专门为dLLMs设计的现有方法可能允许中间输出无法完成为有效句子，这在实践中极大地限制了它们的可靠性。
为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了LAVE，一种专门为dLLMs设计的约束解码方法。我们的方法利用了dLLMs的一个关键特性，即它们在每个前向传递中并行预测所有位置标记分布的能力。当模型提出一个新标记时，LAVE利用这些分布进行前瞻，以高效可靠地验证所提议标记的有效性。这种设计通过可靠地保留中间输出扩展为有效句子的可能性，确保了可靠的约束。在四个广泛使用的dLLMs和三个代表性基准上的广泛实验表明，LAVE持续优于现有基线，并在语法正确性方面取得了显著的改进，同时产生的运行时开销可以忽略不计。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为LAVE的约束解码方法，旨在解决扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）在生成形式语言时遇到的语法不正确问题。LAVE利用dLLMs并行预测标记分布的特性，通过“前瞻-验证”机制来确保生成的中间输出能够最终构成有效的语法结构。实验证明，LAVE在提高语法正确性的同时，对运行时的影响很小。
AI.keywords: 扩散大语言模型, 约束解码, 语法正确性, 无上下文语法, LAVE
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的约束解码方法LAVE，有效地解决了扩散大语言模型在生成形式语言时面临的语法正确性挑战。其“前瞻-验证”机制巧妙地利用了dLLMs的并行预测能力，并确保了中间输出的可完成性，这在现有方法中是一个重要的进步。该方法在实验中表现出优越的性能和较低的计算开销，具有很高的实际应用价值。

title: Transformer-Based Model for Multilingual Hope Speech Detection
comments: 5 pages, 1 figure, PolyHope-M shared task at RANLP2025
summary: This paper describes a system that has been submitted to the "PolyHope-M" at RANLP2025. In this work various transformers have been implemented and evaluated for hope speech detection for English and Germany. RoBERTa has been implemented for English, while the multilingual model XLM-RoBERTa has been implemented for both English and German languages. The proposed system using RoBERTa reported a weighted f1-score of 0.818 and an accuracy of 81.8% for English. On the other hand, XLM-RoBERTa achieved a weighted f1-score of 0.786 and an accuracy of 78.5%. These results reflects the importance of improvement of pre-trained large language models and how these models enhancing the performance of different natural language processing tasks.
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, PolyHope-M shared task at RANLP2025

AI.title_translation: 基于Transformer的多语言希望言论检测模型
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用RoBERTa和XLM-RoBERTa模型来检测英语和德语中的“希望言论”，RoBERTa在英语上取得了最高的F1分数（0.818），证明了预训练模型在NLP任务中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 开发一个用于多语言“希望言论”检测的系统并提交给 "PolyHope-M" 竞赛。
AI.method: 实现了RoBERTa模型用于英语，以及多语言模型XLM-RoBERTa用于英语和德语，并对它们进行了评估。
AI.result: 对于英语，使用RoBERTa的模型报告了0.818的加权F1分数和81.8%的准确率。XLM-RoBERTa在英语和德语上分别取得了0.786的加权F1分数和78.5%的准确率（针对其中一个语言的指标）。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果反映了改进预训练大型语言模型的重要性，以及这些模型如何提高不同自然语言处理任务的性能。
AI.translation: 本文描述了一个已提交给RANLP2025 "PolyHope-M" 的系统。在这项工作中，各种Transformer模型已被实现并评估，用于英语和德语的希望言论检测。RoBERTa被实现用于英语，而多语言模型XLM-RoBERTa被实现用于英语和德语。使用RoBERTa的拟议系统报告了英语的加权F1分数为0.818，准确率为81.8%。另一方面，XLM-RoBERTa实现了0.786的加权F1分数和78.5%的准确率。这些结果反映了改进预训练大型语言模型的重要性，以及这些模型如何提高不同自然语言处理任务的性能。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一个用于英语和德语多语言希望言论检测的系统，该系统评估了不同的Transformer模型。结果显示，RoBERTa在英语上表现稍好，突显了大型预训练模型的性能提升潜力。
AI.keywords: 希望言论检测, Transformer, RoBERTa, XLM-RoBERTa, 多语言处理
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将Transformer模型应用于多语言的“希望言论”（Hope Speech）检测任务，并对比了特定语言模型（RoBERTa）和多语言模型（XLM-RoBERTa）在同一任务上的性能。其局限性在于仅针对英语和德语进行了实验。

title: Inference-Only Prompt Projection for Safe Text-to-Image Generation with TV Guarantees
summary: Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models enable high-quality open-ended synthesis, but their real-world deployment demands safeguards that suppress unsafe generations without degrading benign prompt-image alignment. We formalize this tension through a total variation (TV) lens: once the reference conditional distribution is fixed, any nontrivial reduction in unsafe generations necessarily incurs TV deviation from the reference, yielding a principled Safety-Prompt Alignment Trade-off (SPAT). Guided by this view, we propose an inference-only prompt projection framework that selectively intervenes on high-risk prompts via a surrogate objective with verification, mapping them into a tolerance-controlled safe set while leaving benign prompts effectively unchanged, without retraining or fine-tuning the generator. Across four datasets and three diffusion backbones, our approach achieves 16.7-60.0% relative reductions in inappropriate percentage (IP) versus strong model-level alignment baselines, while preserving benign prompt-image alignment on COCO near the unaligned reference.

AI.title_translation: 用于具有TV保证的安全文本到图像生成的仅推理提示投影
AI.tldr: 研究人员提出了一种新的、无需训练的“提示投影”方法，用于安全地引导T2I扩散模型生成内容，理论上基于总变分（TV）分析了安全与对齐的权衡，并在实验中显示出显著降低不当生成率的同时保持了对良性提示的良好对齐。
AI.motivation: 在文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型的实际部署中，需要在抑制不安全生成和不损害良性提示与图像的对齐之间找到平衡，而这种权衡可以通过总变分（TV）理论来形式化（SPAT）。
AI.method: 提出一个仅在推理阶段运行的提示投影框架，该框架通过一个带有验证的替代目标，将高风险提示映射到可容忍的安全集合中，同时对良性提示几乎不作改动，整个过程不涉及生成器的再训练或微调。
AI.result: 在四个数据集和三种扩散模型骨干上，与强大的模型级对齐基线相比，该方法在不当率（IP）上实现了16.7%至60.0%的相对降低，同时在COCO数据集上将良性提示-图像对齐保持在接近未对齐的参考水平。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过在推理阶段对高风险提示进行投影，实现了在不影响良性提示对齐的情况下，显著降低了不安全生成，并证明了其在TV约束下的理论合理性。
AI.translation: 文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型支持高质量的开放式合成，但其在现实世界的部署需要抑制不安全生成而又不损害良性提示与图像对齐的安全措施。我们通过总变分（TV）的视角形式化了这种张力：一旦参考条件分布确定，任何对不安全生成的非平凡减少必然会导致与参考的TV偏差，从而产生一个原则性的安全-提示对齐权衡（SPAT）。受此观点的指导，我们提出了一种仅在推理阶段运行的提示投影框架，该框架通过带有验证的替代目标选择性地干预高风险提示，将其映射到容忍度受控的安全集合中，同时对良性提示的影响几乎不变，而无需对生成器进行再训练或微调。在四个数据集和三种扩散模型骨干上，我们的方法相对于强大的模型级对齐基线，在不当率（IP）上实现了16.7-60.0%的相对降低，同时在COCO数据集上将良性提示-图像对齐保持在接近未对齐的参考水平。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个名为“仅推理提示投影”的框架，旨在解决文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型中安全生成与提示对齐之间的固有权衡（SPAT，基于TV理论）。该方法通过在推理时对高风险提示进行投影到安全集合，无需模型微调，成功地在保持良性对齐的同时，大幅度降低了不安全输出。
AI.keywords: 文本到图像生成, 安全性, 提示投影, 总变分, 扩散模型
AI.comments: 该方法创新之处在于提出了一个仅在推理阶段起作用的提示投影框架，并从总变分（TV）的角度为安全性和提示对齐之间的权衡提供了理论基础（SPAT）。其优势在于无需重新训练或微调扩散模型，即可有效抑制不安全生成。局限性可能在于“高风险提示”的识别和投影的有效性边界。

title: Tune-Your-Style: Intensity-tunable 3D Style Transfer with Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D style transfer refers to the artistic stylization of 3D assets based on reference style images. Recently, 3DGS-based stylization methods have drawn considerable attention, primarily due to their markedly enhanced training and rendering speeds. However, a vital challenge for 3D style transfer is to strike a balance between the content and the patterns and colors of the style. Although the existing methods strive to achieve relatively balanced outcomes, the fixed-output paradigm struggles to adapt to the diverse content-style balance requirements from different users. In this work, we introduce a creative intensity-tunable 3D style transfer paradigm, dubbed \textbf{Tune-Your-Style}, which allows users to flexibly adjust the style intensity injected into the scene to match their desired content-style balance, thus enhancing the customizability of 3D style transfer. To achieve this goal, we first introduce Gaussian neurons to explicitly model the style intensity and parameterize a learnable style tuner to achieve intensity-tunable style injection. To facilitate the learning of tunable stylization, we further propose the tunable stylization guidance, which obtains multi-view consistent stylized views from diffusion models through cross-view style alignment, and then employs a two-stage optimization strategy to provide stable and efficient guidance by modulating the balance between full-style guidance from the stylized views and zero-style guidance from the initial rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method not only delivers visually appealing results, but also exhibits flexible customizability for 3D style transfer. Project page is available at https://zhao-yian.github.io/TuneStyle.

AI.title_translation: Tune-Your-Style：高斯溅射（Gaussian Splatting）下的强度可调3D风格迁移
AI.tldr: Tune-Your-Style解决了现有3D风格迁移输出固定的问题，通过使用高斯神经元和风格调整器，首次实现了风格强度的精细化调节，使用户可以灵活控制3D场景的内容与风格的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D风格迁移方法大多采用固定输出范式，难以适应用户对不同内容-风格平衡需求的差异，而风格迁移的关键挑战在于平衡内容与风格的图案和颜色。
AI.method: 首先引入高斯神经元显式建模风格强度，并参数化一个可学习的风格调整器以实现强度可调的风格注入；然后提出可调风格化引导，通过跨视图风格对齐从扩散模型获得多视图一致的风格化视图，并采用两阶段优化策略，通过调节完全风格引导和零风格引导之间的平衡，提供稳定高效的引导。
AI.result: 实验证明，我们的方法不仅能生成视觉上吸引人的结果，而且在3D风格迁移方面展现了灵活的可定制性。
AI.conclusion: 我们的方法不仅能生成具有视觉吸引力的结果，而且在3D风格迁移方面表现出灵活的可定制性。
AI.translation: 3D风格迁移是指基于参考风格图像对3D资产进行艺术化风格化。最近，基于3DGS的风格化方法因其显著提高的训练和渲染速度而受到广泛关注。然而，3D风格迁移的一个关键挑战是在内容与风格的图案和颜色之间取得平衡。尽管现有方法都力求获得相对平衡的结果，但固定输出的范式难以适应不同用户对不同内容-风格平衡的需求。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种创新的强度可调3D风格迁移范式，即\textbf{Tune-Your-Style}，它允许用户灵活地调整注入到场景中的风格强度，以匹配他们期望的内容-风格平衡，从而增强3D风格迁移的可定制性。为实现此目标，我们首先引入高斯神经元来显式地建模风格强度，并参数化一个可学习的风格调整器以实现强度可调的风格注入。为促进可调风格化的学习，我们进一步提出了可调风格化引导，该引导通过跨视图风格对齐从扩散模型获得多视图一致的风格化视图，然后采用两阶段优化策略，通过调节来自风格化视图的完全风格引导与来自初始渲染的零风格引导之间的平衡，提供稳定而高效的引导。大量的实验证明，我们的方法不仅能产生视觉上吸引人的结果，而且在3D风格迁移方面表现出灵活的可定制性。项目主页可访问：https://zhao-yian.github.io/TuneStyle。
AI.summary: Tune-Your-Style是一种新颖的强度可调3D风格迁移范式，允许用户灵活调整注入场景的风格强度以匹配所需的内容-风格平衡。该方法通过引入高斯神经元参数化可学习的风格调整器来实现强度控制，并通过结合扩散模型的多视图一致性风格化视图和两阶段优化策略提供稳定引导。
AI.keywords: 3D风格迁移, 强度可调, 高斯神经元, 风格调整器, 扩散模型
AI.comments: 该方法的核心创新在于引入了“强度可调”的概念到3D风格迁移中，利用高斯神经元显式建模风格强度，并设计了可学习的风格调整器和可调风格化引导机制，解决了现有方法输出固定的问题，极大地增强了用户对内容-风格平衡的控制力。方法论上结合了3DGS、扩散模型和两阶段优化策略，具有较高的技术价值。

title: Jailbreaking LLMs via Calibration
summary: Safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) often creates a systematic discrepancy between a model's aligned output and the underlying pre-aligned data distribution. We propose a framework in which the effect of safety alignment on next-token prediction is modeled as a systematic distortion of a pre-alignment distribution. We cast Weak-to-Strong Jailbreaking as a forecast aggregation problem and derive an optimal aggregation strategy characterized by a Gradient Shift in the loss-induced dual space. We show that logit-arithmetic jailbreaking methods are a special case of this framework under cross-entropy loss, and derive a broader family of aggregation rules corresponding to other proper losses. We also propose a new hybrid aggregation rule. Evaluations across red-teaming benchmarks and math utility tasks using frontier models demonstrate that our approach achieves superior Attack Success Rates and lower "Jailbreak Tax" compared with existing methods, especially on the safety-hardened gpt-oss-120b.

AI.title_translation: 通过校准对大型语言模型进行越狱
AI.tldr: 研究人员提出了一种新的框架，将LLM的安全对齐视为对原始数据分布的系统性扭曲，并将“弱到强越狱”问题建模为预测聚合问题。他们推导出了最优的聚合策略（通过梯度偏移表征），并证明了这种方法比现有技术在攻击成功率和模型效用方面更有效。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐在大型语言模型（LLMs）中会产生一个系统性的差异，即模型对齐后的输出与潜在的预对齐数据分布之间存在偏差。
AI.method: 将安全对齐的影响建模为预对齐分布的系统性失真；将弱到强越狱视为预测聚合问题，并推导出由损失诱导的对偶空间中的梯度偏移表征的最优聚合策略；推导出对应于其他适当损失的更广泛的聚合规则家族，并提出了一个新的混合聚合规则。
AI.result: 所提出的方法在红队基准测试和数学效用任务上，与现有方法相比，实现了更高的攻击成功率和更低的“越狱税”，尤其是在安全加固的gpt-oss-120b模型上表现优异。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的安全对齐通常会在模型的对齐输出与潜在的预对齐数据分布之间产生系统性的差异。我们提出了一个框架，其中安全对齐对下一个词预测的影响被建模为对预对齐分布的系统性失真。我们将弱到强越狱视为一个预测聚合问题，并推导出一个最优聚合策略，其特征是损失诱导的对偶空间中的梯度偏移。我们表明，对数算术越狱方法是该框架在交叉熵损失下的一个特例，并推导出了对应于其他适当损失的更广泛的聚合规则家族。我们还提出了一种新的混合聚合规则。在针对前沿模型进行的红队基准测试和数学效用任务上的评估表明，我们的方法与现有方法相比，实现了更高的攻击成功率和更低的“越狱税”，尤其是在安全加固的gpt-oss-120b模型上。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种通过校准来破解大型语言模型（LLMs）安全对齐的方法。研究将安全对齐视为对预对齐分布的系统性扭曲，并将弱到强越狱问题转化为一个预测聚合问题，推导出了最优聚合策略，该策略由损失诱导的对偶空间中的梯度偏移来表征。该框架统一了现有的基于对数器算术的越狱方法，并引入了新的聚合规则。实验结果表明，该方法在多项基准测试中，尤其是在高度安全化的模型上，展现出更高的攻击成功率和更低的性能损失。
AI.keywords: LLM, 安全对齐, 越狱, 梯度偏移, 预测聚合
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将弱到强（Weak-to-Strong）的越狱（Jailbreaking）问题建模为预测聚合问题，并提出了基于梯度偏移的最优聚合策略，这超越了现有的基于交叉熵损失的越狱方法。其重要性在于提供了一种更系统化、更有效的方法来评估和绕过LLM的安全对齐。局限性方面，摘要未明确指出，但可能依赖于对预对齐数据分布的准确建模。

title: Rethinking Zero-Shot Time Series Classification: From Task-specific Classifiers to In-Context Inference
summary: The zero-shot evaluation of time series foundation models (TSFMs) for classification typically uses a frozen encoder followed by a task-specific classifier. However, this practice violates the training-free premise of zero-shot deployment and introduces evaluation bias due to classifier-dependent training choices. To address this issue, we propose TIC-FM, an in-context learning framework that treats the labeled training set as context and predicts labels for all test instances in a single forward pass, without parameter updates. TIC-FM pairs a time series encoder and a lightweight projection adapter with a split-masked latent memory Transformer. We further provide theoretical justification that in-context inference can subsume trained classifiers and can emulate gradient-based classifier training within a single forward pass. Experiments on 128 UCR datasets show strong accuracy, with consistent gains in the extreme low-label situation, highlighting training-free transfer

AI.title_translation: 重新思考时间序列的零样本分类：从特定任务分类器到上下文推理
AI.tldr: 传统TSFM零样本分类依赖有偏见的特定任务分类器。我们提出了TIC-FM，一个基于上下文推理的框架，它用训练数据作为上下文，通过一个结合了编码器、适配器和记忆Transformer的结构，在无需更新参数的情况下完成分类，实验证明其在UCR数据集上性能优异且无需训练。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的零样本分类评估通常采用冻结编码器后接特定任务分类器的做法，这违反了零样本部署的“无需训练”前提，并引入了由分类器依赖性训练选择带来的评估偏差。因此需要一个不依赖特定任务分类器的新方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为TIC-FM的上下文学习框架，该框架将带标签的训练集视为上下文，并在单次前向传播中预测所有测试实例的标签，无需参数更新。TIC-FM结合了时间序列编码器、轻量级投影适配器和一个分掩码（split-masked）的潜在记忆Transformer。此外，还提供了理论论证，证明上下文推理可以包含训练好的分类器，并在单次前向传播中模拟基于梯度的分类器训练。
AI.result: 在128个UCR数据集上展现出强大的准确性，并在极端低标签情况下持续获得性能提升，突显了其无需训练的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，所提出的TIC-FM框架在128个UCR数据集上表现出强大的准确性，尤其是在极低标签情况下（extreme low-label situation）有显著提升，强调了其无需训练的迁移能力。
AI.translation: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的零样本分类评估通常采用冻结编码器后接特定任务分类器的方式。然而，这种做法违反了零样本部署的无需训练前提，并由于分类器依赖的训练选择引入了评估偏差。为解决此问题，我们提出了TIC-FM，一个上下文学习框架，它将带标签的训练集视为上下文，并在单次前向传播中预测所有测试实例的标签，无需参数更新。TIC-FM将时间序列编码器和一个轻量级投影适配器与一个分掩码的潜在记忆Transformer配对。我们进一步提供了理论证明，证明上下文推理可以包含训练好的分类器，并在单次前向传播中模拟基于梯度的分类器训练。在128个UCR数据集上的实验表明了强大的准确性，在极端低标签情况下持续获得提升，凸显了其无需训练的迁移能力。
AI.summary: 本文针对时间序列基础模型（TSFM）零样本分类中因使用特定任务分类器而产生的评估偏差，提出了TIC-FM框架。该框架采用上下文学习范式，将训练数据作为上下文，通过结合时间序列编码器、轻量级适配器和记忆Transformer，实现无需参数更新的单次前向推理，并在UCR数据集上验证了其优越的无需训练的迁移性能。
AI.keywords: 时间序列分类, 零样本学习, 上下文推理, TSFM, 无需训练
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将零样本分类从依赖特定任务的分类器转移到上下文推理（In-Context Inference），这更符合“无需训练”的零样本部署前提。其重要性在于解决了现有评估中存在的评估偏差问题。局限性可能在于“轻量级投影适配器”和“内存Transformer”的实际效率和泛化能力有待进一步验证。

title: Towards Interpretable Hallucination Analysis and Mitigation in LVLMs via Contrastive Neuron Steering
summary: LVLMs achieve remarkable multimodal understanding and generation but remain susceptible to hallucinations. Existing mitigation methods predominantly focus on output-level adjustments, leaving the internal mechanisms that give rise to these hallucinations largely unexplored. To gain a deeper understanding, we adopt a representation-level perspective by introducing sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to decompose dense visual embeddings into sparse, interpretable neurons. Through neuron-level analysis, we identify distinct neuron types, including always-on neurons and image-specific neurons. Our findings reveal that hallucinations often result from disruptions or spurious activations of image-specific neurons, while always-on neurons remain largely stable. Moreover, selectively enhancing or suppressing image-specific neurons enables controllable intervention in LVLM outputs, improving visual grounding and reducing hallucinations. Building on these insights, we propose Contrastive Neuron Steering (CNS), which identifies image-specific neurons via contrastive analysis between clean and noisy inputs. CNS selectively amplifies informative neurons while suppressing perturbation-induced activations, producing more robust and semantically grounded visual representations. This not only enhances visual understanding but also effectively mitigates hallucinations. By operating at the prefilling stage, CNS is fully compatible with existing decoding-stage methods. Extensive experiments on both hallucination-focused and general multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that CNS consistently reduces hallucinations while preserving overall multimodal understanding.

AI.title_translation: 通过对比神经元引导，迈向可解释的LVLM幻觉分析与缓解
AI.tldr: 研究人员发现LVLM的幻觉与特定神经元的激活模式有关，提出了一种名为CNS的方法，通过对比学习来识别和精确调控这些神经元，从而在不影响整体性能的情况下有效减少了模型的幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的幻觉缓解方法主要集中在输出层面，而对导致幻觉的内部机制探索不足，因此需要从表征层面深入理解和解决问题。
AI.method: 首先使用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将密集的视觉嵌入分解为稀疏、可解释的神经元；然后通过神经元级分析识别出“常开神经元”和“图像特异性神经元”；最后，提出对比神经元引导（CNS），通过对比干净输入和噪声输入来识别图像特异性神经元，并选择性地增强信息丰富的神经元，同时抑制由扰动引起的激活。
AI.result: 研究发现幻觉通常是由于图像特异性神经元的破坏或虚假激活引起的，而常开神经元相对稳定；选择性地增强或抑制图像特异性神经元可以控制LVLM的输出，提高视觉接地并减少幻觉；CNS在幻觉相关和一般多模态基准测试中均能有效减少幻觉，同时保持整体多模态理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过对比神经元引导（CNS），可以有效地识别和调控图像特异性神经元，从而增强视觉表征的鲁棒性、提高视觉接地能力并显著减轻幻觉，且该方法兼容现有的解码阶段方法。
AI.translation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）实现了卓越的多模态理解和生成能力，但仍然容易出现幻觉。现有缓解方法主要侧重于输出层面的调整，而导致这些幻觉的内部机制在很大程度上仍未被探索。为了获得更深入的理解，我们采用了表征层面的视角，引入稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将密集的视觉嵌入分解为稀疏、可解释的神经元。通过神经元层面的分析，我们识别出不同的神经元类型，包括常开神经元和图像特异性神经元。我们的发现表明，幻觉通常源于图像特异性神经元的破坏或虚假激活，而常开神经元则基本保持稳定。此外，选择性地增强或抑制图像特异性神经元可以对LVLM的输出进行可控干预，从而提高视觉接地能力并减少幻觉。基于这些见解，我们提出了对比神经元引导（CNS），它通过对比干净输入和噪声输入来识别图像特异性神经元。CNS选择性地放大信息丰富的神经元，同时抑制扰动引起的激活，从而产生更鲁棒和语义上有根据的视觉表征。这不仅增强了视觉理解，而且有效地减轻了幻觉。通过在预填充阶段操作，CNS与现有的解码阶段方法完全兼容。在专注于幻觉和一般多模态基准测试上的广泛实验表明，CNS一致地减少了幻觉，同时保持了整体的多模态理解能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通过对比神经元引导（CNS）来分析和减轻大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）幻觉的新方法。研究人员利用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将视觉嵌入分解为可解释的神经元，发现幻觉与图像特异性神经元的激活异常有关。CNS通过对比学习识别这些关键神经元，选择性地增强或抑制它们，从而在预填充阶段实现对模型内部表征的精确调控，有效提升了视觉接地能力并降低了幻觉，且与现有解码方法兼容。
AI.keywords: LVLMs, 幻觉, 神经元分析, 对比神经元引导, 视觉接地
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地从神经元层面分析了大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）幻觉的内在机制，并提出了基于对比学习的神经元引导（CNS）方法，实现了对模型内部表征的可控干预，这比以往的输出级调整更深入，具有重要的理论和实践意义。局限性在于，分析是基于稀疏自编码器（SAEs）的分解，其有效性依赖于SAE的质量。

title: MoDEx: Mixture of Depth-specific Experts for Multivariate Long-term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) supports critical applications such as traffic-flow management, solar-power scheduling, and electricity-transformer monitoring. The existing LTSF paradigms follow a three-stage pipeline of embedding, backbone refinement, and long-horizon prediction. However, the behaviors of individual backbone layers remain underexplored. We introduce layer sensitivity, a gradient-based metric inspired by GradCAM and effective receptive field theory, which quantifies both positive and negative contributions of each time point to a layer's latent features. Applying this metric to a three-layer MLP backbone reveals depth-specific specialization in modeling temporal dynamics in the input sequence. Motivated by these insights, we propose MoDEx, a lightweight Mixture of Depth-specific Experts, which replaces complex backbones with depth-specific MLP experts. MoDEx achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on seven real-world benchmarks, ranking first in 78 percent of cases, while using significantly fewer parameters and computational resources. It also integrates seamlessly into transformer variants, consistently boosting their performance and demonstrating robust generalizability as an efficient and high-performance LTSF framework.

AI.title_translation: MoDEx：用于多元长期时间序列预测的深度特定专家混合模型
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为MoDEx的新型轻量级模型，用于多元长期时间序列预测。MoDEx通过使用深度特定的MLP专家来替代复杂的骨干网络，并在多个真实世界基准测试中取得了最先进的准确性，同时显著减少了参数和计算资源。
AI.motivation: 现有长期时间序列预测（LTSF）方法通常采用嵌入、骨干网络细化和长视域预测的三阶段流程，但对骨干网络各层的行为探索不足。本研究旨在通过分析层敏感性来揭示深度特定专业化在建模时间动态方面的作用，并以此为动机提出MoDEx模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“层敏感性”的基于梯度的度量方法，该方法借鉴了GradCAM和有效感受野理论，用于量化每个时间点对层潜在特征的贡献。基于层敏感性分析结果，提出MoDEx模型，它使用深度特定的MLP专家来替代复杂的骨干网络，实现轻量化和高效的LTSF。
AI.result: MoDEx在七个真实世界基准测试中实现了最先进的准确性，在78%的情况下排名第一。与现有方法相比，MoDEx使用的参数和计算资源更少。此外，MoDEx可以无缝集成到Transformer变体中，并持续提升其性能，证明了其作为一种高效、高性能LTSF框架的稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MoDEx通过引入深度特定的专家模型，有效地解决了多元长期时间序列预测中的效率和性能问题，并展现了其作为一种通用且高效的LTSF框架的潜力。
AI.translation: 多元长期时间序列预测（LTSF）支持交通流量管理、太阳能调度和电力变压器监控等关键应用。现有的LTSF范式遵循嵌入、骨干网络细化和长视域预测的三阶段流程。然而，各个骨干网络层的行为仍未得到充分探索。我们引入了层敏感性，这是一种受GradCAM和有效感受野理论启发的基于梯度的度量方法，它量化了每个时间点对层潜在特征的积极和消极贡献。将此度量应用于三层MLP骨干网络，揭示了在建模输入序列中的时间动态方面的深度特定专业化。受这些见解的启发，我们提出了MoDEx，一种轻量级的深度特定专家混合模型，它用深度特定的MLP专家取代复杂的骨干网络。MoDEx在七个真实世界基准测试中实现了最先进的准确性，在78%的情况下排名第一，同时使用的参数和计算资源明显更少。它还可以无缝集成到Transformer变体中，持续提升其性能，并证明了其作为一种高效、高性能LTSF框架的稳健泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为MoDEx（深度特定专家混合模型）的新型轻量级多元长期时间序列预测框架。通过引入“层敏感性”度量，研究发现MLP骨干网络层在建模时间动态方面存在深度特定专业化。MoDEx利用这一发现，用多个轻量级、深度特定的MLP专家替代了复杂的骨干网络。实验结果表明，MoDEx在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的准确性，同时显著降低了模型复杂度和计算成本，并能有效提升Transformer类模型的性能。
AI.keywords: 多元长期时间序列预测, 深度特定专家, MoDEx, 层敏感性, 轻量级模型
AI.comments: 该研究在多元长期时间序列预测领域取得了重要进展。通过引入“层敏感性”度量，揭示了现有模型骨干网络层的深度特定专业化现象，为模型设计提供了新的视角。MoDEx模型轻量化、高性能的特点使其具有广泛的应用潜力，尤其是在资源受限或对实时性要求高的场景。然而，对于“层敏感性”度量的计算成本以及MoDEx模型在更复杂或非平稳时间序列上的表现仍需进一步探讨。

title: FaceSnap: Enhanced ID-fidelity Network for Tuning-free Portrait Customization
summary: Benefiting from the significant advancements in text-to-image diffusion models, research in personalized image generation, particularly customized portrait generation, has also made great strides recently. However, existing methods either require time-consuming fine-tuning and lack generalizability or fail to achieve high fidelity in facial details. To address these issues, we propose FaceSnap, a novel method based on Stable Diffusion (SD) that requires only a single reference image and produces extremely consistent results in a single inference stage. This method is plug-and-play and can be easily extended to different SD models. Specifically, we design a new Facial Attribute Mixer that can extract comprehensive fused information from both low-level specific features and high-level abstract features, providing better guidance for image generation. We also introduce a Landmark Predictor that maintains reference identity across landmarks with different poses, providing diverse yet detailed spatial control conditions for image generation. Then we use an ID-preserving module to inject these into the UNet. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach performs remarkably in personalized and customized portrait generation, surpassing other state-of-the-art methods in this domain.

AI.title_translation: FaceSnap：增强身份保真网络，用于免调优肖像定制
AI.tldr: FaceSnap是一种无需微调的肖像定制网络，它使用新的特征融合和地标预测模块，在单次推理中就能从一张参考图中生成高保真、身份一致的定制肖像，并可轻松集成到不同的Stable Diffusion模型中。
AI.motivation: 现有的个性化图像生成方法要么需要耗时的微调且缺乏泛化能力，要么无法在面部细节上实现高保真度。目标是开发一种无需微调、具有高保真度和一致性的定制肖像生成方法。
AI.method: FaceSnap是一种基于Stable Diffusion (SD)的新方法，仅需一张参考图像即可在单次推理阶段产生高度一致的结果。它设计了一个新的面部属性混合器（Facial Attribute Mixer）来提取低级特征和高级特征的融合信息，并引入了一个地标预测器（Landmark Predictor）来跨不同姿势保持参考身份，最后使用一个身份保持模块（ID-preserving module）将这些信息注入到UNet中。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，我们的方法在个性化和定制化肖像生成方面表现出色，超越了该领域其他最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，我们提出的方法在个性化和定制化肖像生成方面表现出色，超越了该领域其他最先进的方法。
AI.translation: 得益于文本到图像扩散模型的显著进步，个性化图像生成，特别是定制肖像生成的研究最近也取得了巨大进展。然而，现有方法要么需要耗时的微调且缺乏泛化能力，要么无法在面部细节上实现高保真度。为解决这些问题，我们提出了FaceSnap，一种基于Stable Diffusion (SD) 的新颖方法，仅需一张参考图像即可在单次推理阶段产生高度一致的结果。该方法即插即用，可轻松扩展到不同的SD模型。具体来说，我们设计了一个新的面部属性混合器（Facial Attribute Mixer），可以从低级特定特征和高级抽象特征中提取综合融合信息，为图像生成提供更好的指导。我们还引入了一个地标预测器（Landmark Predictor），可以在不同姿势下保持参考身份，为图像生成提供多样化但详细的空间控制条件。然后，我们使用一个身份保持模块（ID-preserving module）将这些信息注入到UNet中。实验结果表明，我们的方法在个性化和定制化肖像生成方面表现出色，超越了该领域其他最先进的方法。
AI.summary: FaceSnap是一种新颖的、基于Stable Diffusion的肖像定制方法，它仅需一张参考图像即可在一次推理中生成高身份一致性和高保真度的定制肖像。该方法通过引入“面部属性混合器”和“地标预测器”来增强对身份和面部细节的控制，并且具有即插即用的特性，易于扩展到不同的SD模型。
AI.keywords: 肖像定制, 身份保真, 扩散模型, 面部属性混合器, 免调优
AI.comments: FaceSnap的创新点在于提出了“面部属性混合器”和“地标预测器”，实现了无需微调就能在单次推理中获得高保真度、高身份一致性的肖像定制，解决了现有方法微调耗时或细节保真度不足的问题。其即插即用和易于扩展的特性是其重要优势。

title: From Associations to Activations: Comparing Behavioral and Hidden-State Semantic Geometry in LLMs
summary: We investigate the extent to which an LLM's hidden-state geometry can be recovered from its behavior in psycholinguistic experiments. Across eight instruction-tuned transformer models, we run two experimental paradigms -- similarity-based forced choice and free association -- over a shared 5,000-word vocabulary, collecting 17.5M+ trials to build behavior-based similarity matrices. Using representational similarity analysis, we compare behavioral geometries to layerwise hidden-state similarity and benchmark against FastText, BERT, and cross-model consensus. We find that forced-choice behavior aligns substantially more with hidden-state geometry than free association. In a held-out-words regression, behavioral similarity (especially forced choice) predicts unseen hidden-state similarities beyond lexical baselines and cross-model consensus, indicating that behavior-only measurements retain recoverable information about internal semantic geometry. Finally, we discuss implications for the ability of behavioral tasks to uncover hidden cognitive states.

AI.title_translation: 从关联到激活：比较LLM中行为与隐藏状态的语义几何
AI.tldr: 研究表明，LLM的行为测量（特别是强制选择）可以很好地反映其内部的语义结构（隐藏状态几何），比自由联想更有效，这支持了使用行为任务来探究模型内部表征的可能性。
AI.motivation: 研究的动机在于探究大型语言模型（LLM）的隐藏状态几何（内部表征）在多大程度上可以从其在心理语言学实验中的行为中恢复出来。
AI.method: 对八个指令调优的Transformer模型进行相似性强制选择和自由联想实验，收集17.5M+次试验以构建基于行为的相似性矩阵，然后使用表征相似性分析（RSA）比较行为几何与逐层的隐藏状态相似性，并用FastText、BERT和跨模型共识进行基准测试。最后，对未见词进行回归分析以评估预测能力。
AI.result: 强制选择行为与隐藏状态几何的对齐程度远高于自由联想行为。在未见词的回归中，行为相似性（尤其是强制选择）预测的隐藏状态相似性超过了词汇基线和跨模型共识。
AI.conclusion: 行为相似性，特别是强制选择行为，能够比自由联想行为更好地预测未见词的隐藏状态相似性，这表明仅通过行为测量就可以恢复有关模型内部语义几何的信息。
AI.translation: 我们研究了LLM的隐藏状态几何在多大程度上可以从其在心理语言学实验中的行为中恢复出来。在八个指令调优的Transformer模型中，我们运行了两种实验范式——基于相似性的强制选择和自由联想——针对共享的5000词汇表，收集了超过1750万次试验以构建基于行为的相似性矩阵。使用表征相似性分析，我们将行为几何与逐层的隐藏状态相似性进行比较，并以FastText、BERT和跨模型共识作为基准。我们发现，强制选择行为与隐藏状态几何的对齐程度远高于自由联想。在未见词的回归中，行为相似性（尤其是强制选择）预测的未见隐藏状态相似性超过了词汇基线和跨模型共识，表明仅通过行为测量就可以恢复有关内部语义几何的信息。最后，我们讨论了行为任务在揭示隐藏认知状态方面的能力所带来的启示。
AI.summary: 本研究比较了八种LLM的行为（通过强制选择和自由联想实验获得）与其内部隐藏状态的语义几何之间的关系。研究发现，强制选择行为与隐藏状态几何的对齐程度显著高于自由联想，并且行为数据能够有效预测未见词的内部相似性，表明行为测量保留了可恢复的内部语义信息。
AI.keywords: 隐藏状态几何, 行为数据, 语义相似性, 大型语言模型, 心理语言学
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于系统地比较了两种不同类型的行为数据（强制选择和自由联想）与大型语言模型（LLM）内部的隐藏状态语义几何之间的关系，并量化了它们的可预测性。其重要性在于为使用行为实验来推断模型内部表征提供了实证支持。一个潜在的局限是，研究仅限于八个指令调优的Transformer模型，其结果的普适性可能需要进一步验证。

title: Model-Based Data-Efficient and Robust Reinforcement Learning
summary: A data-efficient learning-based control design method is proposed in this paper. It is based on learning a system dynamics model that is then leveraged in a two-level procedure. On the higher level, a simple but powerful optimization procedure is performed such that, for example, energy consumption in a vehicle can be reduced when hard state and action constraints are also introduced. Load disturbances and model errors are compensated for by a feedback controller on the lower level. In that regard, we briefly examine the robustness of both model-free and model-based learning approaches, and it is shown that the model-free approach greatly suffers from the inclusion of unmodeled dynamics. In evaluating the proposed method, it is assumed that a path is given, while the velocity and acceleration can be modified such that energy is saved, while still keeping speed limits and completion time. Compared with two well-known actor-critic reinforcement learning strategies, the suggested learning-based approach saves more energy and reduces the number of evaluated time steps by a factor of 100 or more.

AI.title_translation: 基于模型的、数据高效且鲁棒的强化学习
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的两级模型学习控制方法，它比纯粹的强化学习方法在节能和学习速度上（效率高100倍以上）表现更好，尤其是在有严格约束的情况下，但无模型方法对模型误差很敏感。
AI.motivation: 开发一种数据高效且鲁棒的学习控制设计方法，特别是在引入硬状态和动作约束时，例如在车辆中减少能耗。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于学习系统动力学模型的两级控制设计方法。高层使用优化程序来满足约束和优化目标（如能耗），低层使用反馈控制器来补偿负载扰动和模型误差。
AI.result: 与两种已知的Actor-Critic强化学习策略相比，所提出的基于学习的方法节省了更多的能源，并将评估的时间步数减少了100倍或更多。无模型方法在包含未建模动态时性能会严重下降。
AI.conclusion: 该模型学习方法在节能和数据效率方面优于传统的Actor-Critic强化学习策略。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种数据高效的学习基于控制的设计方法。它基于学习系统动力学模型，然后在一个两级过程中加以利用。在更高层次上，执行一个简单而强大的优化过程，使得，例如，在引入硬状态和动作约束时，可以减少车辆的能耗。低层次的反馈控制器补偿负载扰动和模型误差。在这方面，我们简要研究了无模型和基于模型的学习方法的鲁棒性，结果表明无模型方法在包含未建模动态时会严重受损。在评估所提出的方法时，假设给定一条路径，同时可以修改速度和加速度以节省能量，同时仍保持速度限制和完成时间。与两种著名的Actor-Critic强化学习策略相比，建议的学习方法节省了更多的能量，并将评估的时间步数减少了100倍或更多。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于学习系统动力学模型的两级控制设计方法，用于实现数据高效和鲁棒的控制。高层优化程序用于在满足硬约束（如车辆能耗）的同时进行优化，低层反馈控制器用于处理扰动和模型误差。实验表明，该方法在节能和数据效率方面显著优于传统的Actor-Critic强化学习方法。
AI.keywords: 模型学习, 数据效率, 鲁棒性, 强化学习, 两级控制
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种基于学习系统动力学模型的两级控制框架，该框架在数据效率和鲁棒性方面优于纯粹的无模型方法。其重要性在于展示了在存在硬约束的情况下，模型学习如何实现高效的优化控制。局限性在于论文中没有详细说明如何处理模型误差和未建模动态的具体机制，只是提到了与无模型方法的对比。

title: Towards Sample-Efficient and Stable Reinforcement Learning for LLM-based Recommendation
summary: While Long Chain-of-Thought (Long CoT) reasoning has shown promise in Large Language Models (LLMs), its adoption for enhancing recommendation quality is growing rapidly. In this work, we critically examine this trend and argue that Long CoT is inherently ill-suited for the sequential recommendation domain. We attribute this misalignment to two primary factors: excessive inference latency and the lack of explicit cognitive reasoning patterns in user behavioral data. Driven by these observations, we propose pivoting away from the CoT structure to directly leverage its underlying mechanism: Reinforcement Learning (RL), to explore the item space. However, applying RL directly faces significant obstacles, notably low sample efficiency-where most actions fail to provide learning signals-and training instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose RISER, a novel Reinforced Item Space Exploration framework for Recommendation. RISER is designed to transform non-learnable trajectories into effective pairwise preference data for optimization. Furthermore, it incorporates specific strategies to ensure stability, including the prevention of redundant rollouts and the constraint of token-level update magnitudes. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets show that RISER significantly outperforms competitive baselines, establishing a robust paradigm for RL-enhanced LLM recommendation. Our code will be available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RISER/.

AI.title_translation: 面向LLM推荐的样本高效且稳定的强化学习方法研究
AI.tldr: Long CoT不适合推荐任务，因为太慢且缺乏用户行为模式。我们转而使用强化学习（RL），但RL效率低且不稳定。我们提出了RISER框架，它能把没用的RL学习轨迹变成有用的成对偏好数据，并采取稳定措施，实验证明RISER在LLM推荐中效果显著。
AI.motivation: 长链式思维（Long CoT）在推荐中的应用存在固有缺陷，主要归因于过高的推理延迟和用户行为数据中缺乏明确的认知推理模式。这促使研究人员转向利用CoT的潜在机制——强化学习（RL）来探索物品空间，但RL本身在推荐中面临样本效率低和训练不稳定的挑战。
AI.method: 提出RISER（Reinforced Item Space Exploration framework for Recommendation），一个新颖的强化学习框架，用于克服直接应用RL的低样本效率和训练不稳定性。RISER通过将不可学习的轨迹转化为有效的成对偏好数据进行优化，并结合防止冗余回滚和限制Token级别更新幅度的策略来确保稳定性。
AI.result: RISER在三个真实世界数据集上进行了广泛实验，结果显示它显著优于竞争基线。
AI.conclusion: RISER在三个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，它显著优于竞争基线，为RL增强的LLM推荐建立了一个稳健的范式。
AI.translation: 尽管长链式思维（Long CoT）推理在大型语言模型（LLMs）中显示出潜力，但其在提高推荐质量方面的应用正在迅速增长。在这项工作中，我们批判性地研究了这一趋势，并认为Long CoT本质上不适合序列推荐领域。我们将这种不匹配归因于两个主要因素：过度的推理延迟和用户行为数据中缺乏明确的认知推理模式。基于这些观察，我们建议转向直接利用其底层机制——强化学习（RL）来探索物品空间，而不是依赖CoT结构。然而，直接应用RL面临重大的障碍，特别是低样本效率（大多数动作未能提供学习信号）和训练不稳定性。为克服这些限制，我们提出了RISER，一个新颖的用于推荐的强化物品空间探索框架。RISER旨在将不可学习的轨迹转化为有效的成对偏好数据以供优化。此外，它还结合了确保稳定性的特定策略，包括防止冗余回滚和限制Token级别的更新幅度。在三个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，RISER显著优于竞争基线，为RL增强的LLM推荐建立了一个稳健的范式。我们的代码将在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RISER/提供。
AI.summary: 该工作批判性地分析了长链式思维（Long CoT）在推荐中的局限性，并提出利用其底层机制——强化学习（RL）来探索物品空间。为解决RL在序列推荐中样本效率低和训练不稳定的问题，作者提出了RISER框架，该框架能将不可学习的轨迹转化为有效的成对偏好数据，并通过特定策略确保训练稳定，最终在实验中取得了显著优于基线的结果。
AI.keywords: LLM推荐, 强化学习, 链式思维, 样本效率, 序列推荐
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地指出了长链式思维（Long CoT）在推荐系统中的局限性，并提出了基于强化学习（RL）的替代方案RISER。其核心贡献在于将RL应用于LLM推荐，并解决了RL在序列推荐中常见的样本效率低和训练不稳定问题，通过将不可学习的轨迹转化为有效的成对偏好数据来实现。方法上具有很强的针对性和实用性。

title: S$^3$POT: Contrast-Driven Face Occlusion Segmentation via Self-Supervised Prompt Learning
summary: Existing face parsing methods usually misclassify occlusions as facial components. This is because occlusion is a high-level concept, it does not refer to a concrete category of object. Thus, constructing a real-world face dataset covering all categories of occlusion object is almost impossible and accurate mask annotation is labor-intensive. To deal with the problems, we present S$^3$POT, a contrast-driven framework synergizing face generation with self-supervised spatial prompting, to achieve occlusion segmentation. The framework is inspired by the insights: 1) Modern face generators' ability to realistically reconstruct occluded regions, creating an image that preserve facial geometry while eliminating occlusion, and 2) Foundation segmentation models' (e.g., SAM) capacity to extract precise mask when provided with appropriate prompts. In particular, S$^3$POT consists of three modules: Reference Generation (RF), Feature enhancement (FE), and Prompt Selection (PS). First, a reference image is produced by RF using structural guidance from parsed mask. Second, FE performs contrast of tokens between raw and reference images to obtain an initial prompt, then modifies image features with the prompt by cross-attention. Third, based on the enhanced features, PS constructs a set of positive and negative prompts and screens them with a self-attention network for a mask decoder. The network is learned under the guidance of three novel and complementary objective functions without occlusion ground truth mask involved. Extensive experiments on a dedicatedly collected dataset demonstrate S$^3$POT's superior performance and the effectiveness of each module.

AI.title_translation: S$^3$POT：通过自监督提示学习进行对比驱动的人脸遮挡分割
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为S$^3$POT的对比驱动框架，结合人脸生成和自监督空间提示，以解决人脸遮挡分割问题。该方法利用人脸生成器重建被遮挡区域，并利用基础分割模型提取精确掩码，通过参考生成、特征增强和提示选择三个模块实现。实验证明了该方法的优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的人脸解析方法通常会将遮挡误分类为面部组件，因为遮挡是一个高层概念，而非具体的物体类别。构建涵盖所有遮挡物体类别的真实世界人脸数据集几乎不可能，且精确的掩码标注劳动密集。因此，需要一种新的方法来解决人脸遮挡分割问题。
AI.method: S$^3$POT框架结合了人脸生成和自监督空间提示。它包含三个模块：参考生成（RF）、特征增强（FE）和提示选择（PS）。RF使用解析掩码的结构引导生成参考图像；FE通过对比原始图像和参考图像的tokens来获得初始提示，并用该提示增强图像特征；PS基于增强的特征，构建正负样本提示，并通过自注意力网络进行筛选，用于掩码解码器。该网络在没有遮挡真实掩码的情况下，通过三个新颖且互补的目标函数进行学习。
AI.result: 在专门收集的数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，S$^3$POT 具有卓越的性能，并且每个模块都有效。
AI.conclusion: S$^3$POT 通过对比驱动的框架，结合人脸生成和自监督空间提示，成功实现了人脸遮挡分割，解决了现有方法在处理遮挡问题上的不足，并在实验中证明了其优越性和各模块的有效性。
AI.translation: 现有的人脸解析方法通常会将遮挡误分类为面部组件。这是因为遮挡是一个高层概念，它不指代具体的物体类别。因此，构建一个涵盖所有遮挡物体类别的真实世界人脸数据集几乎是不可能的，并且精确的掩码标注是劳动密集型的。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了S$^3$POT，一个结合人脸生成和自监督空间提示的对比驱动框架，以实现遮挡分割。该框架的灵感来源于以下见解：1）现代人脸生成器能够逼真地重建被遮挡区域，生成保留面部几何结构但消除遮挡的图像；2）基础分割模型（例如SAM）在提供适当提示时能够提取精确的掩码。具体来说，S$^3$POT 包含三个模块：参考生成（RF）、特征增强（FE）和提示选择（PS）。首先，RF模块利用解析掩码的结构引导生成参考图像。其次，FE模块执行原始图像和参考图像之间tokens的对比，以获得初始提示，然后通过交叉注意力用该提示修改图像特征。第三，基于增强的特征，PS模块构建一组正负样本提示，并使用自注意力网络对其进行筛选，以用于掩码解码器。该网络在没有任何遮挡真实掩码的情况下，在三个新颖且互补的目标函数的指导下进行学习。在专门收集的数据集上进行的广泛实验证明了S$^3$POT的卓越性能和每个模块的有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为S$^3$POT的对比驱动人脸遮挡分割框架，该框架结合了人脸生成和自监督空间提示技术。针对现有方法将遮挡误分类为面部组件的问题，S$^3$POT利用人脸生成器重建被遮挡区域，并结合基础分割模型的提示能力来提取精确的分割掩码。该框架通过参考生成、特征增强和提示选择三个模块协同工作，并在无遮挡真实掩码的情况下，利用新颖的目标函数进行训练。实验结果表明，S$^3$POT在人脸遮挡分割任务上表现优越，并且框架中的各个模块都发挥了重要作用。
AI.keywords: 人脸遮挡分割, 自监督学习, 提示学习, 对比学习, 人脸生成
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的人脸遮挡分割方法S$^3$POT，通过结合对比学习、自监督学习和提示学习，有效解决了现有方法在处理遮挡问题上的局限性。该方法利用人脸生成器重建被遮挡区域，并利用基础分割模型的提示能力，在没有遮挡真实掩码的情况下进行训练，这大大降低了数据标注的成本。框架设计的三个模块（参考生成、特征增强、提示选择）协同工作，实现了高效且准确的遮挡分割。然而，该方法在处理极端或复杂遮挡情况下的鲁棒性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Equilibrium of Feasible Zone and Uncertain Model in Safe Exploration
summary: Ensuring the safety of environmental exploration is a critical problem in reinforcement learning (RL). While limiting exploration to a feasible zone has become widely accepted as a way to ensure safety, key questions remain unresolved: what is the maximum feasible zone achievable through exploration, and how can it be identified? This paper, for the first time, answers these questions by revealing that the goal of safe exploration is to find the equilibrium between the feasible zone and the environment model. This conclusion is based on the understanding that these two components are interdependent: a larger feasible zone leads to a more accurate environment model, and a more accurate model, in turn, enables exploring a larger zone. We propose the first equilibrium-oriented safe exploration framework called safe equilibrium exploration (SEE), which alternates between finding the maximum feasible zone and the least uncertain model. Using a graph formulation of the uncertain model, we prove that the uncertain model obtained by SEE is monotonically refined, the feasible zones monotonically expand, and both converge to the equilibrium of safe exploration. Experiments on classic control tasks show that our algorithm successfully expands the feasible zones with zero constraint violation, and achieves the equilibrium of safe exploration within a few iterations.

AI.title_translation: 安全探索中可行域与不确定性模型的均衡
AI.tldr: 为了安全地探索环境，我们发现必须在“探索的范围”（可行域）和“我们对环境的了解程度”（环境模型的不确定性）之间找到平衡点。我们提出的SEE算法通过不断地扩大探索范围并同时精确化模型，最终收敛到这个安全探索的理论最佳平衡状态。
AI.motivation: 在强化学习中确保环境探索的安全性是一个关键问题。虽然将探索限制在可行域内是公认的方法，但尚未解决如何找到可实现的最大可行域及其识别方法。
AI.method: 提出安全均衡探索（SEE）框架，该框架交替执行两个步骤：寻找最大可行域和最小不确定性模型。使用图论形式化不确定性模型进行分析和证明。
AI.result: 实验证明，SEE算法能够在零约束违反的情况下成功地扩展可行域，并在几次迭代内达到安全探索的均衡状态。理论上证明了SEE获得的模型是单调精化的，可行域是单调扩展的，并且两者都收敛到均衡点。
AI.conclusion: 安全探索的目标是找到可行域与环境模型之间的均衡点。所提出的SEE框架通过交替更新两者，能够单调地收敛到安全探索的均衡状态。
AI.translation: 在强化学习中确保环境探索的安全性是一个关键问题。虽然将探索限制在可行域内已成为公认的方法，但关键问题仍未解决：通过探索能实现的最大可行域是多少，以及如何识别它？本文首次通过揭示安全探索的目标是在可行域与环境模型之间找到均衡，从而回答了这些问题。这一结论基于对这两个组成部分相互依赖的理解：更大的可行域带来更准确的环境模型，而更准确的模型反过来又能支持探索更大的区域。我们提出了第一个面向均衡的安全探索框架——安全均衡探索（SEE），它通过在寻找最大可行域和最小不确定性模型之间交替进行。使用不确定性模型的图论形式化，我们证明了SEE获得的模型是单调精化的，可行域是单调扩展的，并且两者都收敛到安全探索的均衡点。在经典控制任务上的实验表明，我们的算法在零约束违反的情况下成功地扩展了可行域，并在几次迭代内达到了安全探索的均衡状态。
AI.summary: 本文首次将安全探索的目标定义为可行域与环境模型之间的均衡状态，解决了如何找到最大可行域的问题。为此，作者提出了安全均衡探索（SEE）框架，通过交替地最大化可行域和最小化模型不确定性，证明了该过程将单调收敛到安全探索的均衡点。实验验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 安全探索, 可行域, 环境模型, 均衡, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将安全探索问题建模为可行域与环境模型之间的“均衡”问题，并提出了首个基于此均衡概念的算法SEE。其重要性在于为安全探索提供了一个理论框架和可收敛的求解方法。局限性在于摘要中未提及算法在复杂环境下的扩展性和计算效率。

title: VIZOR: Viewpoint-Invariant Zero-Shot Scene Graph Generation for 3D Scene Reasoning
summary: Scene understanding and reasoning has been a fundamental problem in 3D computer vision, requiring models to identify objects, their properties, and spatial or comparative relationships among the objects. Existing approaches enable this by creating scene graphs using multiple inputs such as 2D images, depth maps, object labels, and annotated relationships from specific reference view. However, these methods often struggle with generalization and produce inaccurate spatial relationships like "left/right", which become inconsistent across different viewpoints. To address these limitations, we propose Viewpoint-Invariant Zero-shot scene graph generation for 3D scene Reasoning (VIZOR). VIZOR is a training-free, end-to-end framework that constructs dense, viewpoint-invariant 3D scene graphs directly from raw 3D scenes. The generated scene graph is unambiguous, as spatial relationships are defined relative to each object's front-facing direction, making them consistent regardless of the reference view. Furthermore, it infers open-vocabulary relationships that describe spatial and proximity relationships among scene objects without requiring annotated training data. We conduct extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations to assess the effectiveness of VIZOR in scene graph generation and downstream tasks, such as query-based object grounding.
